item.title: Nigeria palm oil output hits 1.57m tonnes in 2025
item.description: Nigeria’s palm oil production has risen to 1.57 million tonnes in 2025, reflecting steady growth over the past five years and reigniting international interest in the country’s ambition to reclaim a leading position in the global palm oil market. item.title: Lagos enforces 5% withholding tax on gaming payouts
item.description: The Lagos State Government has announced the commencement of a 5% withholding tax (WHT) on gaming payouts, directing all licensed betting companies operating in the state to begin immediate automatic deductions from customers’ winnings.
